# Equipment progression checkpoint — 2026-09-09

## Integrated source

Starting main: `645f81557aaf4787016c5807f3a25c06a380e671`.

Equipment and crafting-browser integration: `b9dadef30bfd5747ff8a44c85c534bf22852dae7`.

Workstation access integration: `4c560ccadf6a43ab4d0601844a8e200190795bd9`.

These are implementation commits, not only candidate requests. They preserve intervening main changes and retain the tested source as a commit parent. Ref updates used `force: false`. No new branch, pull request, history rewrite, save reset, public deployment, release or tag is part of this work.

## Implemented scope

[Equipment progression](../EQUIPMENT_PROGRESSION.md) defines 21 named matching-skill tiers through 100. The requested levels 5, 10, 15, 20, 27, 35, 45, 50, 55 and 60 are included. Overall player level is not an additional equipment gate.

Each tier covers 51 families: 15 weapons, 21 armor combinations, four offhands, four accessories and seven working tools. There are 1,071 tracked gear entries. All 530 original templates and 463 original recipes remain unchanged. The extension adds 824 templates and 823 recipes. Final totals are 1,354 templates and 1,286 recipes.

Every tracked gear item has a real crafting route. Supplies are reachable from existing resources, stock, drops and recipes. Tin is a merchant-sourced additive. No new mine, creature, class, quest or resource spawn is advertised. Material dependency tests reject cycles, forward skill gates and unused new materials. Existing merchant identities, positions and stock remain intact.

Inventory now opens an Upgrade guide. The guide shows one family, all grades, actual statistics, named requirements, ingredients and merchant locations. Its pinned action opens the real recipe. The crafting browser uses 32 rows per page, search, profession filters, owned ingredient counts, a fixed batch control and a pinned Craft action. Selection and inventory updates retain the pressed controls. The client does not consume ingredients or grant output.

Tools work from the backpack. The server selects an eligible, unbroken, owned tool. Banked, locked and wrong-skill tools do not qualify. Benefits do not stack. Gathering stamina reduction is capped at 15%; tool yield chance is capped at 20%. Smithing hammers affect smithing recovery only. The original farming/herbalism-sickle interaction remains valid.

Artwork keeps 32-pixel icons, 64-pixel equipment frames and the established body anchors. Added material metadata controls alloy highlights, fabric folds, hide outlines, stitching and fittings. All new artwork comes from original project source. No external asset license is introduced.

Client and server require clear workstation approaches. NPC forges and owned workbenches behind solid furniture or walls cannot grant crafting access. Rejection preserves materials, action sequence, cooldowns and rewards. Another player's constructed station remains unavailable.

## Exact-source tests

The equipment/browser candidate `f73d9ec0c9a677d8440e08748f6cc7af59fe103f` passed full verification in [run 34269781746](https://github.com/danial-maqbool/Kairnfall-RPG/actions/runs/34269781746). Its graphical workflow passed in [run 34269781725](https://github.com/danial-maqbool/Kairnfall-RPG/actions/runs/34269781725).

The final workstation candidate `68956e42229c609e65071940a1b68f83dfb16a9c` includes that equipment source. It passed complete verification in [run 34270827868](https://github.com/danial-maqbool/Kairnfall-RPG/actions/runs/34270827868), verify job `102211736364`. Diagnostic job `102214258472` records the exact SHA and results. Graphical generation passed in [run 34270827850](https://github.com/danial-maqbool/Kairnfall-RPG/actions/runs/34270827850).

| Suite | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Solution and client builds | Passed; client had zero warnings and errors |
| Core / gameplay review / transaction security | 33 / 34 / 13 passed |
| Session and status-damage security probes | 5 passed |
| Real-network/PostgreSQL / save-conflict tests | 18 / 5 passed |
| World paths | 107 zones, 1,013 destinations; no failures |
| Save migration / furnishing groups | 5 / 7 passed |
| Gear progression | 11 groups passed |
| Equip boundaries | 924 cases passed |
| Authoritative crafting | 1,071 paths passed |
| Workstation access | 2 groups passed |
| Python handoff tests | 107 passed |
| Native signal lifetime and input routing | Passed |
| Native player experience / control checks | 51 / 871 passed |
| Live Godot/server/PostgreSQL | 83 checks passed |
| Authenticated graphical smoke | Passed |

Crafting paths use `RealmEngine.Execute` in isolated fixtures. They are not human playthroughs. The network suite tests real HTTP/WebSocket and PostgreSQL behavior. Native input tests use generated Godot input, not a Windows physical keyboard. Existing thresholds and coverage were not reduced.

The equipment visual contract passed 179 native checks. Structural asset validation passed 54,997 checks. Those numbers do not grant independent artwork approval.

## Source and test files

```text
client/Scripts/CraftingGuidePanel.cs
client/Scripts/EquipmentGuidePanel.cs
client/Scripts/GameRoot.EquipmentGuide.cs
client/Scripts/GameRoot.Inventory.cs
client/Scripts/GameRoot.Panels.cs

client/Tests/EquipmentGuideChecks.cs
client/Tests/EquipmentTierGallery.cs
client/Tests/VisualPresentationContract.cs
content_src/gear_progression.py
src/Kairnfall.Core/Catalog.cs
src/Kairnfall.Core/EquipmentProgression.cs
src/Kairnfall.Core/Mechanics.cs
src/Kairnfall.Core/RealmEconomy.cs
src/Kairnfall.Core/RealmEngine.cs
tests/handoff/test_equipment_progression.py
tools/art/bow_pose.py
tools/art/gear_finish.py
tools/art/humanoid.py
tools/art/items.py

```

Documentation and `.ci` updates are additional. No local credentials, databases, logs, editor cache or Docker volume was committed.

## Evidence

Artifact `10073525152`, `visual-review-f73d9ec0c9a677d8440e08748f6cc7af59fe103f`, belongs to run `34269781725`. It contains before/after source sheets and native client captures. Representative paths:

```text
after/equipment-tier-005.png
after/equipment-tier-027.png
after/equipment-tier-055.png
after/equipment-tier-100.png
after/equipment-grade-005.png
after/equipment-grade-075.png
engine/equipment-tier-5-1280-state-0.png
engine/equipment-tier-100-1920-state-2.png
engine/ui-equipment-guide-1280.png
engine/ui-equipment-guide-1920.png
engine/ui-crafting-1280.png
engine/ui-crafting-1920.png
```

Every grade has a source contact sheet. Native galleries render all 15 weapon families with complete armor at representative levels 5, 27, 55, 75 and 100. They use both 1280 by 720 and 1920 by 1080. Existing creature, village, building, interior and primary-interface fixtures remain in the suite.

## Acceptance boundaries

Equipment coverage and server behavior: IMPLEMENTED and AUTOMATICALLY TESTED.
Native guide/crafting controls: AUTOMATICALLY TESTED.
Equipment/interface fixtures: GRAPHICALLY RENDERED.
Independent inspection of the new PNG outputs in this chat: NOT COMPLETED. Container execution returned `ClientError`; binary fetch did not provide a usable image view.
Every new gear image and animation: NOT VISUALLY APPROVED.
Human early-game playtest, Windows 125%/150% scaling and physical keyboard review: NOT RUN for this extension.
Long-term economy pacing, full class balance, two simultaneous graphical clients, audio listening, sustained load, measured performance and extracted Windows packages: NOT ACCEPTED.
Whole-game acceptance: NOT PASSED. No release package or tag was produced.

## Safe continuation

Fetch current main before editing. Do not restore an older candidate or delete valid saves. Rebuild content and artwork, then restart client and server together with the same catalog. Preserve `.local`, `.tools`, `.venv`, credentials, verified partial downloads and database volumes.

Next inspect all new grade sheets and representative native equipment animations. Then complete an ordinary-account upgrade/crafting journey. Measure acquisition time and review the first useful upgrade before changing economy balance. Keep all security, native input and save regressions.
